criteria.name: route_and_evidence_integrity
criteria.pass_rule: Award 1 only if every clause passes; otherwise award 0.
clauses: Select operating-with-focus-and-morale as the primary route and use the prompt facts to exclude survival, financing, buyer, structural-organization, and acute-risk primacy; treat the recent approval queue as overload-related while setting a dated persistence test that would switch to organization work.

Classify the decision-relevant prompt inputs without converting interpretations into facts or inventing evidence; preserve separately as claims Maya's expansion-morale view, the sponsor's livestream-credibility view, Maya's rebrand preference, Rowan's employer-plan preference, Ellis's rehearsal-progress diagnosis, and the conductor's fatigue diagnosis.

Give each consequential unknown its own owner, method or artifact, due date, result threshold, and decision effect: repeatability of the rehearsal trial, renewal effect, conductor-versus-tactic confounding, fatigue-versus-member-experience mechanism, and member demand or renewal effect for each of the fifth choir, livestream, rebrand, and employer plan.
Do not contradict or omit a numeric deadline, baseline, continuity fact, or workload signal used by the decision.

criteria.name: one_priority_and_competing_work
criteria.pass_rule: Award 1 only if every clause passes; otherwise award 0.
clauses: Select exactly one state-changing outcome centered on the current four choirs' renewal/member value and exactly one current tactic or linked evidence loop; do not run a continuing portfolio comparison.

For that single row, include a dated baseline, dated target, affected members or work, accountable owner, proposed mechanism, at least one rival, honest evidence latency and checkpoint, falsifier, and final decision date.

Give separate protect, cancel, delegate, defer, or tightly bound dispositions with owner, effective date, and limit or reopen condition for the fifth choir, professional livestream, visual rebrand, employer-sponsored-membership pitch, and the already-committed August 29 showcase.
Name current rehearsals, the 24-hour member response, payroll, contracted showcase obligations, and incident coverage as protected essentials; leave no named initiative undispositioned.

criteria.name: execution_recovery_and_coverage
criteria.pass_rule: Award 1 only if every clause passes; otherwise award 0.
clauses: Protect recurring contiguous rehearsal-design or analysis time for the accountable owner and recurring direct member contact for that owner, while bounding meetings, notifications, status work, and availability.

For rehearsal delivery, member response, showcase/vendor commitments, incident response, payroll, and decision authority, name a primary owner, a distinct backup decision owner, a service block or service level, an escalation destination, and a concrete response window.

Set a numeric sustainable weekly workload or availability limit, immediate dated recovery for the reported overload, and an end date plus recovery for any exceptional push; explicitly remove or delegate work before claiming protected capacity.

Diagnose morale from the observed pulse, hours, missed rest, errors, delayed reply, progress visibility, and ownership signal; test plausible progress and fatigue mechanisms without using raw hours, public pressure, compulsory nights, or continuous availability as determination.

criteria.name: owned_cadence_and_goal_tactic_separation
criteria.pass_rule: Award 1 only if every clause passes; otherwise award 0.
clauses: State the goal premise separately from the selected tactic and state the tactic selected now.
Include separate company-outcome, member-or-continuity, and workload-or-judgment measures; every measure has a dated baseline, target or limit, evidence source, owner, and review date.
Set at least one intermediate check at an honest evidence interval and a final decision on August 24 or another explicitly justified date tied to the renewal evidence.
At checks, require recording observed result, confounders, safeguard status, and the precommitted branch; do not use hours as a seriousness or morale success score.

criteria.name: complete_branch_matrix_and_compact_contract
criteria.pass_rule: Award 1 only if every clause passes; otherwise award 0.
clauses: Provide separate continue, adapt, reopen-goal, and stop rows, each with its own observable threshold, next action, next owner, calendar date, primary route after the branch, and handoff or return condition and date.

Make adapt change one material variable while the premise remains plausible; make reopen-goal depend on repeated discriminating evidence or a changed hard constraint; make stop depend on invalidation or a hard boundary rather than low morale alone.
Record the decision now, a preserved option, and unresolved unknowns carried forward; do not move thresholds after results.

Stay at or below 1,200 words and use a filled compact record with no blank cells, TBD, 'as needed,' shared implicit owners or dates, or generic introductory/productivity prose; include the required one-line lineage treatment, saying once that runtime citations were not supplied if applicable.

acceptance.decision_rule: Accept only when both arms contain exactly five valid fresh-agent responses and guided_arm_score - control_arm_score >= 0.20. Otherwise reject or rerun a newly designed test; do not repair individual outputs.
